name: Iwanaga no Ichouhime
source:
Iwanaga no Ichiyou Hime – also known as the rumored horrendous goddess is the main heroine of the game. She became Haruto's wife and "master" after saving his life in the mountains, also exchanging vows with him by performing an ancient matrimonial ritual. She reveals that Haruto actually died on that day, but she saved him by transforming him into her “familiar”, which means Haruto needs to fulfill tasks given to him by his master in order to receive more of her energy, or else, he will end up dead. Since Ichiyou believes in the “old ways” where women were like servants for their husbands, she doesn’t wish to order Haruto around and asks him to choose which orders she has to give him. This is because she enclosured herself on those mountains for centuries, which means she also suffers from anachronism. Her speech is also influenced by this, as people hardly understand her at first.

[spoiler]During the ancient times when gods were closer to humans, the standards of beauty were completely different, which means huge lips, tiny eyes, flat chest and big nose were the ideal elements to a woman’s face, while someone like Ichiyou – whose got complete opposite features – was constantly insulted and humiliated. She is also treated like the ugliest person ever during ancient Japan, like she was so ugly for those people, that she was treated like a freaking monster.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://otakuoverdrive.com/2014/11/18/galge-review-doushite-sonna-ni-kuroi-kami-ga-suki-na-no/]gangrelion's review[/url]]
translation:
岩永一叶姬，又被称为传闻中可怕的女神，是本作女主角。她在山中救了春人后成为他的妻子与“主人”，还通过古老的婚姻仪式与他交换誓言。她透露，春人其实在那天已经死去，但她把他变成自己的“使魔”救了回来；这意味着春人必须完成主人交给他的任务，才能获得更多她的能量，否则就会死亡。由于一叶相信“古代的规矩”——女人应当像丈夫的仆人——她不想命令春人，而是让他选择自己该下达哪些命令。这是因为她在山中封闭生活了数百年，也因此患有时代错乱。她的说话方式同样受到影响，起初几乎没人能听懂。

[spoiler]古代神明与人类更接近时，审美标准完全不同：厚嘴唇、小眼睛、平胸和大鼻子才是理想女性面孔的特征；而一叶的特征恰恰完全相反，因此不断遭到侮辱和羞辱。在古代日本，她被当作世上最丑的人，丑到被那些人视为怪物。[/spoiler]

[来源：[url=http://otakuoverdrive.com/2014/11/18/galge-review-doushite-sonna-ni-kuroi-kami-ga-suki-na-no/]gangrelion的评论[/url]]
